text: {"assertions":["A crash loop issue in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml was caused by an off-by-one error in slice bounds.","The crash loop only manifested with deeply nested inputs beyond six levels deep.","The root cause was fixed and submitted as PR #2068 on branch fix/crash-loop-1.","A property test was added alongside the fix to prevent similar off-by-one errors in the future.","The fix was validated by rolling out to a small node pool for testing.","CI testing uses manifest lint and dry run checks to verify the Kubernetes deployment YAML.","After 80 days of nightly rollups, the deployment counts matched the source counts, indicating stable operation."]}
